tips_en: Read FrontierPhysics first: its fully agentic, physicist-validated benchmark reveals that leading models solve only 27.4% of open-ended physics tasks, with failures concentrated in reasoning rigor and expert intuition, making it the clearest guide to current AI-for-science limitations. VFlash and WeLM-Image are valuable companion reads because they demonstrate specialized advances in embodied-planning efficiency and unified visual generation, respectively, but neither tests whether models can conduct rigorous, publishable research.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 FrontierPhysics：其面向 physicists 真实项目、覆盖完整研究流程的基准显示，领先模型仅完成 27.4% 的任务，主要短板是严谨推理与专家直觉，因此最能揭示当前 AI for Science 的能力边界。VFlash 与 WeLM-Image 可作为延伸阅读，分别展示具身规划效率和统一视觉生成的技术突破，但二者都未评估模型能否独立完成严谨且可发表的研究。
